title: Curvature of y = x² at the origin
caption: At x = 0 the curvature is κ = 2, so the circle that best fits the parabola has radius 1/κ = ½: it touches at (0, 0) and its top is at (0, 1).
alt: The parabola y = x squared and the circle of radius one half centred at (0, 1/2), touching it at the origin.
description: y′ = 2x and y″ = 2, so at x = 0 the curvature is κ = 2/(1 + 0)^(3/2) = 2.
The osculating circle has radius 1/κ = ½ and centre (0, ½).
It hugs the parabola at the origin; at x = 1 the curvature is lower, 2/5^(3/2) ≈ 0.179.
